messages:
Tara (Support): Hey team — customer (acct 0x7f... / acme.ai) seeing lots of 429s during a demo. Root says "rate limit exceeded" in response body. Repro steps from customer below.

Eli (SRE): Got the logs? Any X-RateLimit headers? 429s could be per-route or per-minute burst cap.

Tara (Support): They pasted curl repro:

curl -i -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-..." \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-small","prompt":"test","max_tokens":512}'

Response snippet:
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"rate limit exceeded","code":"rate_limit","retry_after":30}

Tara (Support): They say it happens after ~160 requests/minute. They're on Free plan with trial credits. They expected short demo bursts to be allowed.

Akshay (Auth): Can you grab their headers from our ingest logs? Specifically X-RateLimit-Limit/X-RateLimit-Remaining/X-RateLimit-Reset and any plan tags.

Eli (SRE): Pulled logs: user_id=acct_0x7f, route=/v1/generate, plan=free, concurrency=4, rate_limit_window=60s, limit=120/min. X-RateLimit-Remaining goes to 0 -> 429. They were sending bursts of 200 qps for ~20s.

Tara (Support): Ok can we offer a short-term burst exception for the demo? Customer insists on same-day demo.

Jordan (Sales): If they convert to paid (Team plan) we can bump to 1k/min and enable a trial temporary uplift. For demo we can approve a 2-hour grace window at 500/min if finance signs off. I'll handle handoff — cc @billing-bot

billing-bot: Request created: TEMP-UPLIFT-#8241. Needs approval from finance. ETA 2–4h. (automated)

Tara (Support): While billing reviews, can we suggest a quick client-side mitigation? e.g., add exponential backoff + jitter, and token lower max_tokens.

Akshay (Auth): Also suggest spreading requests across multiple API keys if they have subaccounts. But note: that won't bypass account-level quota.

Eli (SRE): If they need immediate short-term demo, we can do a manual "demo-burst" policy: increase rate_limit for plan=free, acct_0x7f to 500/min for 2 hours, tracked by special tag. Need approval from Jordan + billing.

Jordan (Sales): Approved contingent on signed trial contract via sales ops. I'll ping finance.

Tara (Support): Customer provided repro with timestamps. I added `X-Debug-Request-ID` header and asked them to re-run. Also requested app logs showing retries.

Tara (Support): Quick FAQ I'll send them:
- Why 429? Free plan hard cap to prevent noisy tenants.
- Short-term workaround: reduce concurrency, lower max_tokens, implement jittered backoff.
- Upgrade path: Team/Pro tiers for higher baseline + option for reserved Dedicated.

Eli (SRE): One more thing — logs show they hit the burst protection (short burst tolerance) earlier today; our automatic fallback routed some requests to secondary model (gpt-small-quant), that had slightly different latency. Not relevant to quota but FYI.

Akshay (Auth): After uplift (if approved) we should ensure token billing is gated — don't accidentally waive charges. Jordan, confirm sales will accept standard trial billing terms.

Jordan (Sales): Confirmed. We'll capture an MSA addendum if they need >30d uplift. For demo under 48h, standard trial OK.

Tara (Support): Ok I'll reply to customer with mitigation + ETA for uplift. If finance approves, ask them to re-run after 30m.

quota-bot: Account acct_0x7f: current_limit=120/min, temp_request=500/min (pending), expiry=N/A (pending approval).

Tara (Support): Tagging @Eli @Akshay — if you OK the manual tweak after billing signoff, I'll apply via admin console and note the change for audit.

Eli (SRE): OK. Please document change with start/end times and link to ticket TEMP-UPLIFT-#8241.

Tara (Support): Will do — thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
